comments.why: Disney project using gears and linkages with simulation.
comments.text: Is there a standard way to formally describe a mechanical machine? Similar to how a .obj file defines a 3d shape? Some standard way of describing piece types, interactions, properties, movement ranges, etc. Then one could have a computer use the format to learn/find interesting configurations based on a catalog like [LINK] especially if paired with simulation like done in this Disney research project using gears and linkages [VIDEO]
